item.title: Thousands of Venezuelans stage march for end to repression
item.description: CARACAS (AFP): Thousands of Venezuelans demonstrated on Thursday to demand the release of all remaining political prisoners and full freedoms a month after the overthrow of autocratic leader Nicolas Maduro. “We are not afraid,” the demonstrators chanted at the first major opposition rally since Maduro’s capture by US forces, creating scenes that would have been […]

item.title: Bangladesh’s BNP wins historic parliamentary election
item.description: DHAKA (Reuters) : The Bangladesh Nationalist Party won a landmark parliamentary election on Friday (Feb 13), local TV stations showed, as ballots were counted through the night in a pivotal vote that is expected to restore political stability. item.description: TOKYO (AFP) : Japan seized a Chinese fishing boat and arrested its skipper, authorities said Friday, an incident that could deepen a spat between the Asian giants. item.title: North Korea warns of ‘terrible response’ if South sends more drones
item.description: SEOUL (AFP) : North Korea on Friday (Feb 13) threatened a “terrible response” if it detects any more drones buzzing across the border from the South. item.title: Cyclone Gezani destroys 18,000 homes and causes at least 36 deaths in Madagascar
item.description: ANTANANARIVO, Madagascar (AP) : Cyclone Gezani killed at least 36 people, injured more than 370 and destroyed almost 18,000 homes across Madagascar, authorities said Thursday. Madagascar’s president has declared a national disaster and made a plea for international leaders to help the largely poor Indian Ocean island. item.description: SYDNEY (AFP) : Australia’s opposition Liberal Party elected as leader on Friday a conservative who lobbied to drop its commitment to net zero emissions, as it seeks to counter an insurgent populist right and rebuild support after a disastrous election loss last year.
